business_metrics.renewable_metric_interpretation: The signed request defines exogenous renewable energy that would otherwise be curtailed. Report remaining curtailment as requested absorption energy minus validated net-load increase, floored at zero. This is request-relative avoided curtailment, not curtailment inferred from unconstrained PV power flow.
